{{Top|leg}}
'''Colicoid cargo ships''' were massive, utilitarian ships built for ingenuity and practical uses rather than style. Their [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] designers, by compressing living space, made possible an ability to pack more cargo into their spaces than any other type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] or [[Container ship/Legends|container ship]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Although it blocked lighting, ceilings, too, were fitted with finely spun [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] nets with which to suspend cargo boxes, while the overall effect created an atmosphere of claustrophobic gloom; needless to say, space for any other purpose which might be antithetical to the transport of freight was always at a premium.<ref name="Path to Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>

Even the Colicoid [[Diplomatic barge|diplomatic ships]] were cargo ships pressed into service to assume a diplomatic function. As a result, [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury]] and beauty were best put out of mind for anyone seeking the ships' services who traveled aboard, for cabins and public areas were purposefully cramped and oddly shaped, mostly tucked into stray corners. At best, the ships' anti-aesthetic appearance could only be described as ugly.<ref name="Path to Truth" />

In [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his 13-year-old [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], embarked on a mission to protect against attack by the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Pirate/Legends|raider]] [[Krayn]] one such Colicoid cargo vessel—which, by the nature of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] duo's presence, meant that the freighter, piloted by Captain [[Anf Dec]], had been pressed into service as a diplomatic barge. The two shared a cramped cabin with narrow [[Sleeper (furniture)|sleep-couches]].<ref name="Path to Truth" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (comic series)|''Jedi Quest'']] comic, [[Jude Watson]]'s original Colicoid ''cargo''-turned-''diplomatic'' ship is shown instead to be a standard [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Corellian Engineering Corporation|Corellian]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class diplomatic cruiser]].
